name: Solarworld Energy Solutions Ltd
title: Solarworld Energy Solutions Ltd - 544532 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Solar EPC-plus-module integrator guides FY27 revenue near INR2,000 crore (70% of INR2,800 crore order book) with margins 8–11%, but module line utilisation is only ~40–45% on captive orders and the cell line is not until June 2027.

utilisation.quote: that will give me a utilization of maybe close to about 40%, 45%. As we add more orders, I think we should expect a 60%, 65% utilization for that line.

capex.peers_comment: Management said other manufacturers are setting up capacity for DCR cells, and ALMM-2 cell shortage expected for 6-12 months.
capex.quote: other manufacturers are definitely setting up capacities as well

triggers.label: Module line utilisation ~40-45% on captive orders
triggers.quote: that will give me a utilization of maybe close to about 40%, 45%

triggers.label: Margin range cut to 8-11% from prior 11% PAT
triggers.quote: So we would say somewhere between 8% to 11% is where we should lie in terms of overall margins.

triggers.label: Copper up ~40%, aluminium ~50% vs Oct 2025
triggers.quote: copper compared to October 2025, copper is maybe up by about 40%. Aluminum is up by about 50%.

triggers.label: FY27 revenue ~INR2,000 crore
triggers.quote: maybe close to INR2,000 crores in the current -- in FY27.

triggers.label: Cell line delayed to June 2027
triggers.quote: The commercial operation is targeted by June 2027.

guidance.value: ~INR2,000 crore (70% of INR2,800 crore order book)
guidance.quote: maybe close to INR2,000 crores in the current -- in FY27.
So we would say somewhere between 8% to 11% is where we should lie in terms of overall margins.
It should go to about, maybe close to about INR800 crores to INR1,000 crores this year.
I would say that we achieve a break-even maybe at about a 30%, 35% utilization on that line.

prior_guidance_check.metric: Revenue INR1,500 crore with 11% PAT margin (promised in Q1)
prior_guidance_check.quote: in Q1, we had promised that you'd give us a 1500-floor top line with an 11% PAT margin.
we have decided that this line will start by June 2027 commercially.

red_flags.label: Missed prior top-line and margin promise
red_flags.quote: in Q1, we had promised that you'd give us a 1500-floor top line with an 11% PAT margin.

red_flags.label: SJVN receivables and claims unrecognised
red_flags.quote: we are entitled to various kind of claims like idling charges, interest charges on delayed payment and loss of profit charges.

red_flags.label: Cell line funds unspent, timeline slipped
red_flags.quote: we have not spent anything from the funds which we have raised for solar cell.

evasions.quote: Very difficult to predict, but we'll try to achieve what we are seeing over the year.
Sir I really can't predict that.
I would not be able to answer that question very correctly.
